dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: The theme isn't bad, but as for the plot... I wonder if it's good enough...

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler! My apologies. I got distracted for a moment thinking about light novels...

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: Is there anything I can help you with?
